obligations.condition: Create a dedicated account with a generated password. Check returned same-account tokens, positive-integer expiry and the separate 3600-second expectation. Verify ownership by marker/email and independent UID lookup, then persist/reread UID before mutation.
Prove the original password authenticates as the same UID and obtain a fresh ID token for the password change.

Change to an exactly six-character URL-safe ASCII password using the fresh baseline ID token under explicit minimum-six client policy. Preserve only input lengths, ASCII and distinctness in public inputShape. Check same-account returned ID/refresh presence and expiry, then actually use both through later cases.
Use the update response ID token and compare selected account fields with pre-change lookup.
Under recorded improved email privacy, original-password signin must return HTTP400 INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS. An arbitrary error, disabled-account error or throttling is not equivalent.
After old-password rejection, use the update ID token to compare selected fields with the pre-rejection lookup, preserving missing/null/type distinctions.
The replacement password authenticates as the original UID/email and returns usable credentials.
Use the new-password signin ID token and compare selected fields to the original account.
Use the password update response refresh token with grant_type=refresh_token. Check same UID, token fields, bearer type and expiry.
Use the refreshed ID token and compare selected fields to the original account.
Delete the dedicated account using the refreshed end-user ID token after verified UID ownership confirmation.
Exact UID and email Admin selectors both confirm account absence. Unknown UID remains unresolved; recovered identity is persisted before any cleanup deletion.

limitations: Exactly one random six-character URL-safe ASCII update; not all character combinations or maximum/Unicode/null/empty boundaries.
Short-lived dedicated test account with no production user data. No password security recommendation.
Token-use/state projections are recorder testimony; no independent JWT signatures, elapsed expiry, revocation timing, SDK/Rules or fault-injected recovery.

preconditions.condition: Require explicit schema 1 ENFORCE policy with min 6 / max 4096 and no extra strength options. Original password is 47 characters; distinct replacement is exactly six URL-safe ASCII characters. Record and validate only inputShape, never password bytes or hashes.
